_meta.description: Blacksmith subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: shields, armor break, thorns.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la puissance des boucliers de 1% et l'armure de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases shield power by 1% and armor by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la penetration d'armure de 0.8% et l'ATK de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases armor penetration by 0.8% and ATK by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les degats d'epines de 0.8% et la reduction de degats de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases thorns damage by 0.8% and damage reduction by 0.5% per level.
